_doc: The self-serve page at romefeller.app/bot (onboard/server.mjs). No secret here: the invite's
SHA-256 and the bot's key PATHS come from the environment variables named below.
chains.<chain>
template        the profile whose tuning every new instance copies (ops/add_profile.py)
venues          venues in order of preference; only those with vault rules and a pool count
approveVenues   Solana: how many of them (the first) a new vault approves; its profile opens on
the first. Each venue adds policies to the setup (measured on a fork 2026-10-12,
two payout wallets: Raydium 0.02745 SOL, Meteora 0.03377, Raydium+Orca 0.05119,
all four 0.09748). A new profile is pinned to its pool (add_profile), and the
board does not yet keep a vault to its approved pools, so more than one venue
costs gas the vault cannot use yet; all four would raise the SOL minimum to ~0.25
poolsKey        Solana: the key in chains/solana/solana.json that maps venue -> pool
pool            EVM: the one pool
operatorWallet  the operator's profit wallet (Solana: a solana.json key). A request whose
profit wallet is this one is the operator's own (special, no fee share);
any other pays fee.bps of its payout-token fees to it
tokens          what an owner can deposit. Solana: mintKey names a solana.json key. EVM:
the chain module's export of that name; native: the chain's coin, which
the page wraps first (wrapsTo) because a vault never wraps
gas             what the owner pays the bot's key, in the native coin, before the bot spends
anything: setup (one connect, measured on a fork: Solana 2026-10-11 0.03282 SOL
for create, 3 policies (Meteora), leave, lookup table with 2 payout wallets;
2026-10-12 Raydium 0.02745, see approveVenues; Polygon
1,872,109 gas = 0.347 POL at 185 gwei), a margin over it (fees and gas prices
move), and the instance's running gas (Solana: gas_reserve_sol 0.05 + the DLMM
open headroom 0.05). confirmations (EVM): blocks a payment needs on top
tokens.min      the least pool capital; a native deposit must also cover the gas
tokens.fees     the native coin the page's Max keeps back for the owner's own transactions
with this token: the gas payment and the deposit. Solana: two signatures
(0.00001), the wallet's rent-exempt floor (0.00089088: a System account may
not drop below it unless it is empty) and, for a token, the vault's token
account the deposit creates (0.00203928), with room for a priority fee.
Polygon: the gas of the payment, the wrap and the transfer (a token: the
payment and the transfer) at 500 gwei. Max of a token takes the whole
balance; the native coin must then hold the bot's gas and these fees
intentTtlS: how long a message to sign is good for; paymentSlackS: how much older than the
signed request its gas payment's block time may be (block clocks drift).
limits: {max, windowS} per client address unless said; vaultsPerOwner counts every vault
the owner's wallet owns or is creating: 1, one pool per wallet; more capital goes into that
vault (Add capital). service.start runs with {name} replaced by a checked profile name.
walletConnect: WalletConnect v2 (Reown) for wallets that do not live in the browser (Tangem,
Ledger Live, any mobile wallet). projectId: a free Reown Cloud project id (cloud.reown.com),
not a secret; the environment variable projectIdEnv wins over it. Empty: the page offers
the browser's own wallets only. relayUrl: the relay the page talks to; verify: the origins of
WalletConnect's verify service (a hidden frame that lets a wallet show this site as verified).
The page's CSP allows exactly these, and only when a project id is set.
capHeadroom: a vault profile's max_usd is 2 x side_cap_fraction x capHeadroom x the dollars of
every deposit (onboard/store.py cap): all of the capital deploys, with room for the price and
the fees to grow into.
chains.<chain>.botKeys: the bot's public keys (Solana: the payer, then the policy key; EVM: the
key), pinned: the server does not open a chain whose key files are other keys, and the page
(built from this file) refuses a payment or a rule that names any other key.
